title: Welcome to Alt Vegas
content: This dream version of Las Vegas exists as a series of older atrium style buildings along a single desert street. Outside of the handful of casinos nobody appears to live here and there are constant sandstorms making it difficult to walk between buildings. Every casino is an atrium style building, incredibly small by Vegas standards with a casino in the middle. Nothing in these casinos appears to have been touched since the 1970’s, even the slot machines haven’t been updated in 50 years.
